name: MMR Group, Inc.
old_description: MMR Group consistently ranks at the top of Engineering News-Record's annual specialty contractors list. We're no stranger to 1 million work-hour projects, and we manage 30 offices throughout North and South America.
about:
MMR Group, Inc. is headquartered in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, and operates 30 offices throughout North and South America. The company’s founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, but it has grown into a specialty contractor consistently ranked at the top of Engineering News-Record’s annual list.

The firm provides electrical construction, instrumentation, power distribution, panel and modular control building fabrication, telecommunications and security systems, commissioning and start-up, power development, maintenance, mission critical construction, and power engineering and utility services. It self-performs electrical, telecommunications, security, fire alarm, and gas services, and recently opened a Modular Systems facility in Lafayette, Louisiana, to assemble and test data center skids off-site. With approximately 725 employees, MMR routinely manages projects exceeding one million work-hours.

MMR serves the chemical and petrochemical, oil and gas (upstream, midstream, downstream), industrial manufacturing, power generation, renewable energy and energy storage, and telecommunications sectors. Project references include the Black Hills Energy Cheyenne Prairie Power Project (Wyoming), Kinder Morgan Elba Island 35kV/15kV project (Georgia), Shell Canada Albian Oil Sands Expansion (Alberta), Procter & Gamble tissue machine plant (Missouri), GE/Entergy Perryville energy storage system (Louisiana), and Chevron’s Big Foot production platform (Gulf of Mexico).

The company attributes its differentiation to diverse expertise across broad sectors, a commitment to safety and quality, state-of-the-art project controls, cutting-edge technology, and a workforce of certified craftsmen. It emphasizes completing projects on schedule and within budget since inception.
